mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_message (userId, deviceId, content, type, isUser, read_status, createTime) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{content}, #{type}, #{isUser}, #{readStatus}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, userId, deviceId, content, type, isUser, read_status AS readStatus, createTime FROM device_message WHERE userId = #{userId} AND deviceId = #{deviceId} ORDER BY createTime ASC
